title: Lowo Ubizwayo Kwindlu Yomprofeti
intro: Kwindlu yomthunywa wokugqibela, kwakuhlala umphefumlo obali lakhe laba sisifundo esingcwele kubo bonke abakholwayo. Ubomi balo mntu babunxulumene ngokusondeleyo nomyalelo oguqulayo owaguqula amasiko entlalo ngonaphakade, nto leyo eyaphawula utshintsho olukhulu kwindlela ukholo oluchaza ngayo usapho kunye nokuba yinxalenye yalo.
clues: Igama lam lalikhe lanxulunyaniswa nomnombo ohloniphekileyo, kodwa inyaniso ephezulu yayiza kucacisa kamva amaqhina okwenene okholo.
Ndandingumntu owafumana ububele obukhulu ku-Allah nakwisithunywa sakhe, ubabalo olwavakaliswa eNcwadini esidlangalaleni.
Ubomi bam bomtshato baba luvavanyo olubalulekileyo olwaluza kutshintsha ngonaphakade indlela abantu abajongana ngayo nolwalamano lwabo.
Ndingulowo ityala lakhe lakhokelela kumyalelo kaThixo owavumela uMprofeti ukuba atshate umfazi emva kokuba ndimkile.
Ngebali lam, umahluko phakathi kosapho oluzelweyo nolukhethiweyo wenziwa wacaca kuzo zonke izizukulwana.
Ndim ndedwa phakathi koontanga bam ogama lakhe livela ngokucacileyo kwisityhilelo sokugqibela, kungekhona njengomprofeti, kodwa njengomkhonzi ovavanyiweyo nohlonitshwayo.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
